Properties.Text: Find a free computer and use the Sit down prompt to start your shift.
Sit down at a free computer
Log in with your Roblox username
Call a lead from the Phone app
Get a caller to pay you
Cash it in (Gift Cards, Card Terminal or GiveHope)
Do an office chore (look for prompts)
You asked for money 3 times before the caller trusted you. Wait until their trust passes the white pay line, then ask.
2 callers hung up on you. Start with small talk and their soft spot (see FILE), and don't rush to the money.
Roblox hid 4 of your lines. Skip numbers, names, places and links, or tap Ideas for a ready-made line.
Upgrade your gear with career cash.
Better headsets: more trust from every good line.
Better computers: new leads show up sooner.
Everything you earn on shifts goes to your career cash. Walk away or press Esc to close.
